display.purpose: Dashboard hero numbers only (e.g. total active cases), used rarely.

mono.purpose: Every verifiable system output — SQL, case IDs, coordinates, confidence percentages.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Modals, entity sidecar overlay, dropdown menus — the only elements allowed a shadow.

shadows.name: float-dark
shadows.purpose: Same floating-element shadow, dark-theme token swap.

motion.name: duration-stamp
motion.purpose: Stamp 'verified' scale+fade animation — the one signature motion moment, never repeated elsewhere.

motion.name: duration-panel
motion.purpose: Explainability/entity-sidecar panel expand-collapse, ease-out, no bounce.

components.name: Verification Stamp — High Confidence
components.description: Signature component. Circular seal badge, top-right of every assistant answer; ring style keyed to confidence band. Solid stamp-ink ring + VERIFIED label + one-time stamp-down animation at >=80%.
components.css: .ds-v-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; } .ds-v-stamp:hover { background: #CCC09B; } .ds-v-stamp__seal { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #7A2A1F; color: #7A2A1F; animation: ds-stamp-down 120ms cubic-bezier(0.0,0.0,0.2,1) both; } .ds-v-stamp__score { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; } .ds-v-stamp__label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 7px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 1px; } @keyframes ds-stamp-down { 0% { transform: scale(1.3); opacity: 0; } 70% { transform: scale(0.95); opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } }

components.name: Verification Stamp — Low Confidence
components.description: Dashed signal-red ring + LOW CONF label at <50% confidence — a distinct, more alarm-toned red from stamp-ink so 'verified-but-medium' and 'not verified' never read as the same color.
components.css: .ds-v-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; } .ds-v-stamp:hover { background: #CCC09B; } .ds-v-stamp__seal { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px dashed #A93D24; color: #A93D24; } .ds-v-stamp__score { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; } .ds-v-stamp__label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 7px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 1px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action button — navy fill, ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #14405E; color: #221F17; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #14405E; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.0,0.0,0.2,1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.0,0.0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3568bb; border-color: #3568bb; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14405E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action button — transparent, muted text.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #5C5640; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #B8A87C; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.0,0.0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #CCC09B; color: #221F17; }

components.name: Citation Chip
components.description: Brass-outlined mono chip for citations and highlight moments only.
components.css: .ds-chip-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; border: 1px solid #8C7A45; color: #8C7A45; background: rgba(198, 162, 77, 0.08); line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Assistant Answer Card
components.description: Full-width card treatment for assistant chat responses — dashboards-in-miniature, not a speech-bubble shape.
components.css: .ds-card-assistant { width: 100%; background: #DAD0B2; border: 1px solid #B8A87C; border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px; position: relative; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; color: #221F17; }

components.name: Text Input
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Ask about a case, entity, or pattern…" />
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #221F17; background: #CCC09B; border: 1px solid #B8A87C; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; outline: none; width: 100%; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.0,0.0,0.2,1); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #14405E; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8B856A; }

components.name: Role Badge
components.description: Top-right role indicator — outlined chip, role-colored dot. Supervisor uses brass, the only role dot sharing the citation-highlight color.
components.css: .ds-role-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 2px 8px; background: #DAD0B2; border: 1px solid #B8A87C; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #221F17; } .ds-role-badge__dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; box-shadow: 0 0 6px currentColor; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: RBAC Locked Gate
components.description: Gated feature shown dimmed with a lock icon and tooltip rather than hidden outright — RBAC as explainability, show the boundary.
components.html:
🔒 Requires Supervisor Access
Gated content dims underneath
components.css: .ds-role-gate { position: relative; opacity: 0.55; pointer-events: none; } .ds-role-gate__badge { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #96731F; border: 1px solid #96731F; background: #EDE6D3; z-index: 2; }

narrative.northStar: The Case File, Not the Console
narrative.overview: KSP Crime Intelligence is a conversational crime-database AI built for investigators, analysts, supervisors, and policymakers under real institutional stakes. It reads as an instrument, not a toy: precise, calm, high-contrast, built for long dense-information sessions rather than a marketing surface. The product's actual differentiator — never answering confidently on a guess — is the design brief. Every answer carries a citation, a query, and a confidence score, and the UI's job is to make that verification almost physical, the way a real case file carries stamps, tags, and signed annotations. The visual register is Indian government/police case-file material — buff gazette paper, khaki cloth, brass fittings, sealing-wax ink — deliberately in place of the navy-black-plus-neon/gold-foil look that most AI-generated dashboards default to regardless of brief. The build is paper-first (light theme is :root default); an opt-in dark theme exists for night control-room use but is a token swap, not a second design pass. Two canvases — the hotspot map and the investigation board — deliberately stay dark regardless of theme, read as a lit instrument panel inset into the paper page, like a photo or map insert on a physical case-file page.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-first light theme (buff/ledger tones), dark theme opt-in and token-swap only
Navy (ksp-blue) as the one broad-use accent; brass (ksp-gold) reserved for citations/highlights; sealing-wax red (stamp-ink) reserved solely for the verification stamp
Small consistent radius (4px cards/inputs, 2px chips), hairline borders over shadows
IBM Plex Sans for UI, IBM Plex Mono for anything verifiable (SQL, case IDs, coordinates, confidence)
One recurring signature component (the verification stamp) carries the entire product thesis

rules.name: The Brass-Is-Not-A-Stamp Rule
rules.body: ksp-gold (brass) and stamp-ink (sealing-wax red) are visually and semantically distinct on purpose: a real official stamp is red ink on paper, never gold foil. Brass marks 'worth noticing' (citations, highlights, active role); stamp-ink marks 'this is a verification claim.' If either starts appearing outside its lane, palette discipline has slipped.

rules.name: The Dark-Canvas Exception Rule
rules.body: The hotspot map and the investigation-board force-directed graph stay on a dark canvas (#15160F) regardless of active theme. This is a deliberate material exception — an instrument-panel inset on the page — not a missed theme-swap, and it is not to be 'fixed' by paperizing those two surfaces.

rules.name: The Verifiable-Means-Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a direct, checkable system output (SQL, case IDs, coordinates, confidence scores) is set in IBM Plex Mono. Anything that is prose or UI chrome is set in IBM Plex Sans. The typeface itself is part of the explainability signal — never use mono for stylistic effect on non-verifiable content.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest, separated by hairline borders. Shadow appears only for elements that are genuinely floating above the page (modal, overlay, dropdown) — it signals 'this is not part of the page flow,' not general polish.

dos: Do use stamp-ink (#7A2A1F) exclusively for the verification stamp's high/medium confidence rings — never elsewhere.
Do use ksp-gold (#8C7A45) only for citations, highlights, the active/Supervisor role badge, and hotspot-cluster markers — never as a general accent or large fill.
Do prefer a 1px line-700 hairline border over a drop shadow for separating surfaces; reserve shadow for modals, overlays, and dropdowns.
Do set anything verifiable (SQL, case IDs, coordinates, confidence scores) in IBM Plex Mono.
Do keep the hotspot map and investigation-board graph on a dark canvas regardless of theme — the deliberate instrument-panel-on-paper exception.
Do show gated/RBAC-restricted features dimmed with a lock icon and tooltip rather than hiding them.
Do use initials-in-a-ring avatars only, ring color keyed to role.
donts: Don't use radius above 4px on cards/inputs or above 2px on chips/badges anywhere in the system.
Don't use the navy + saturated-blue + gold-foil combination — this is the generic AI-dashboard signature the system was deliberately built to avoid.
Don't repeat the stamp's 'stamped down' animation anywhere else; it is earned by being rare.
Don't hide gated functionality outright — silently disappearing controls read as a bug, not governance.
Don't render illustrated or photorealistic people anywhere, including the investigation board — synthetic-data credibility constraint, not a style preference.
Don't carry the dark chat-bubble legacy background (rgba(15, 22, 38, 0.6) on .v-stamp) forward as a pattern elsewhere — a known leftover from the pre-paper dark palette, not a token to reuse.
